name: DM2024OGTT01
title: Diagnostic support: type 2 diabetes mellitus, OGTT pathway (CQL)
description: Suggests a type 2 diabetes diagnosis when the two-hour plasma glucose after a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test is at or above 11.1 mmol/L on two separate occasions, or once with classic hyperglycaemic symptoms or a hyperglycaemic crisis. Source: Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Type 2 Diabetes in Jamaica, Ministry of Health and Wellness, December 2024. CQL translation of TSV rule DM-2024-OGTT-01, checked against the TSV engine.
usage: Needs Observations coded with SNOMED CT (113076002 with the 2 hours qualifier 123030002) and values in mmol/L, and Conditions coded with SNOMED CT. Makes the repeat-if-asymptomatic footnote executable. Confirm the intended symptom/crisis definition with the guideline authors.

action.title: Oral glucose tolerance test pathway
action.description: The two-hour OGTT criterion is diagnostic when supported by classic hyperglycaemic symptoms or hyperglycaemic crisis, or when an abnormal result is confirmed on a separate occasion.
